name: view_select_field
description: LP-4b: the Pass Editor's View field comes from the engine's view_axes. The fixture carries the cube_capture feature as a project feature, so its passes can be edited. cube_capture_ssao_blur is opened by its heading: its View field is one combo for the cube's face, named by the engine's labels, and nothing is typed. Picking 2 (+Y) and saving sends view_select, get_frame_plan reports it on the node and the canvas draws 'view: face 2 (+Y)' under the heading; All views and Save take it out again, and the line goes.
